_about: Everything tunable in the Shoot Log (app/post_shoot_log.py): the tag vocabulary, the limits behind each check, how frames are viewed. There is deliberately no score here: the back-test on his real edits (learning/shoot_log_backtest.py, 2026-11-01) found sorting by Claude's rating no better than chance, so nothing ranks clips.

checks._levels_note: Grey code values, 0..1, as the clip reader sees them. S-Log3: black 95/1023, mid grey 420/1023, 90% white 598/1023, and real frames top out at about 0.87. Rec.709: black 64/1023, white 940/1023.
checks._near_duplicate_note: The best match between any two per-second thumbnails. 0.85 called people in similar light duplicates; 0.89 kept the real ones on the Birkenstock shoot, judged by eye. One shoot only: look again on the next.

viewing_curve._note: Only for the review page and the frames Claude sees, so flat Log can be judged. The footage itself is never changed.
